ApiKey.descriptionEn: The API key and its source access policy. Resetting the credential preserves the API key ID and source access policy.
ApiKey.description_en: The API key information, which describes an API key used to access the sandbox service, including its ownership, status, and access control configuration
ApiKey.description_zh: API Key 信息。描述一个用于访问沙箱服务的 API Key 及其归属、状态和访问控制配置

apiKeyID.description_en: The unique identifier of the API key, in UUID format
apiKeyID.description_zh: API Key 的唯一标识，为 UUID 格式

apiKeyMask.description_en: The masked value of the API key. It retains the prefix and the first and last four characters, and replaces the middle characters with four asterisks for secure display in the user interface
apiKeyMask.description_zh: API Key 的掩码值，保留前缀和首尾各 4 位字符，中间以 4 个星号代替，用于在界面上安全展示

apiKeyName.description_en: The name of the API key. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, spaces, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and half-width periods (.)
apiKeyName.description_zh: API Key 名称。长度不超过 128 个字符，仅支持字母、数字、空格以及短横线（-）、下划线（_）和半角句点（.）

apiKeyValue.description_en: The plaintext value of the API key, which starts with e2b_. This value is returned only in the responses of the create, import, and reset operations, and is not returned by other operations
apiKeyValue.description_zh: API Key 明文值，以 e2b_ 开头。仅在创建、导入和重置接口的响应中返回，其余接口不返回

createdTime.description_en: The creation time of the API key, in UTC and RFC 3339 format
createdTime.description_zh: API Key 的创建时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 RFC 3339

expireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the API key, in UTC and RFC 3339 format. An empty value indicates that the API key never expires
expireTime.description_zh: API Key 的过期时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 RFC 3339。留空表示永不过期

ipBlacklist.description_en: The IP address blacklist. After configuration, the IP addresses in the list cannot use the API key. This parameter is mutually exclusive with ipWhitelist
ipBlacklist.description_zh: IP 黑名单。配置后列表内的 IP 地址不能使用该 API Key。与 ipWhitelist 互斥

items.description_en: A single IP address access control rule
items.description_zh: 单条 IP 访问控制规则

ipWhitelist.description_en: The IP address whitelist. After configuration, only the IP addresses in the list can use the API key. This parameter is mutually exclusive with ipBlacklist
ipWhitelist.description_zh: IP 白名单。配置后仅列表内的 IP 地址可以使用该 API Key。与 ipBlacklist 互斥

items.description_en: A single IP address access control rule
items.description_zh: 单条 IP 访问控制规则

lastUsedTime.description_en: The time when the API key was last used, in UTC and RFC 3339 format. This value is empty if the API key has never been used
lastUsedTime.description_zh: API Key 最近一次被使用的时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 RFC 3339。从未使用时为空

resourceGroupID.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the team belongs
resourceGroupID.description_zh: 团队所属的阿里云资源组 ID

source.description_en: The source of the API key. Valid values: generated (generated by the service) and custom (imported by the user)
source.description_zh: API Key 的来源。取值：generated（由服务生成）、custom（由用户导入）

status.description_en: The status of the API key. Valid values: active (enabled) and inactive (disabled). A disabled API key can no longer be used to access the sandbox service
status.description_zh: API Key 状态。取值：active（启用）、inactive（停用）。停用后该 Key 不能再用于访问沙箱服务

teamID.description_en: The ID of the team to which the resource belongs, in UUID format
teamID.description_zh: 资源所属团队的 ID，为 UUID 格式

teamPlan.description_en: The team plan edition. Valid values: eco (Economy), std (Standard), pro (Professional), and ent (Enterprise)
teamPlan.description_zh: 团队套餐规格。取值：eco（经济型）、std（标准型）、pro（专业型）、ent（企业型）

userID.description_en: The user ID of the resource creator, in UUID format
userID.description_zh: 资源创建者的用户 ID，为 UUID 格式

username.description_en: The username of the API key creator
username.description_zh: API Key 创建者的用户名

vpcBindings.descriptionEn: The allowed source VPC IDs for this API key. An omitted field or an empty array means no VPC source restriction. With a non-empty list, requests must satisfy both this VPC policy and any configured IP policy. ResetApiKey preserves this list when rotating the credential.
vpcBindings.description_en: The set of source VPC IDs allowed for this API key. An omitted or empty array indicates that no VPC source restrictions are configured. If the array is not empty, requests must meet both this VPC restriction and the configured IP source policies. This list is retained when credentials are rotated by calling ResetApiKey
vpcBindings.description_zh: 此 API Key 允许的来源 VPC ID 集合。省略或空数组表示未配置 VPC 来源限制。非空时，请求必须同时满足此 VPC 限制及已配置的 IP 来源策略。ResetApiKey 轮换凭证时保留此列表

items.descriptionEn: A source VPC ID allowed to use this API key.
items.description_en: The source VPC ID allowed to use this API key
items.description_zh: 允许使用此 API Key 的来源 VPC ID
items.title: 允许的来源 VPC ID

vpcBindings.title: 允许使用 API Key 的来源 VPC 列表

IPConfig.descriptionEn: An IPv4 source rule in an API key allowlist or denylist.
IPConfig.description_en: The IP access control rule. It describes an IP address or CIDR block used for API key access control
IPConfig.description_zh: IP 访问控制规则。描述一条用于 API Key 访问控制的 IP 地址或网段

description.descriptionEn: The description of this source IP rule.
description.description_en: The description of the IP rule. The length cannot exceed 128 characters
description.description_zh: 该条 IP 规则的备注说明，长度不超过 128 个字符
description.title: 规则描述

ipAddress.descriptionEn: An IPv4 address or IPv4 CIDR block.
ipAddress.description_en: The IPv4 address or CIDR block. IPv6 is not supported
ipAddress.description_zh: IPv4 地址或 CIDR 网段，暂不支持 IPv6
ipAddress.title: IPv4 地址或 CIDR 网段

description_en: Queries the list of API keys by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询 API Key 列表
kebab_example: aliyun sandbox list-api-keys --api-key-name dev --status Success --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --team-id 70d1c834-0383-58d8-97ac-5336eb91abcd --resource-group-id rg-acfmwxqyrgwabcd --user-id 123456789 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApiKeys

parameters.help_en: The name of the API key
parameters.name: api_key_name

parameters.help_en:
Filters API keys by status. Valid values:
active: Enabled.
inactive: Disabled
parameters.help_zh: 按 API Key 状态筛选。取值：active（启用）、inactive（停用）
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 页码。默认值为 1，取值范围为 1～10000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of API keys to return per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的 API Key 数量。默认值为 10，取值范围为 1～100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the creator
parameters.name: user_id

items.description_en: The information about an API key
items.description_zh: 单个 API Key 的信息

code.description_en: The response code. The value is 200 if the request is successful

message.description_en: The response message. The value is success if the request is successful
message.description_zh: 响应消息。成功时为 success

pageNumber.description_en: The page number of the current query

pageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for the current query
pageSize.description_zh: 本次查询使用的每页条数

total.description_en: The total number of API keys that meet the query conditions
total.description_zh: 符合查询条件的 API Key 总数
